NETWORK: No internet connection. Check your connection and try again.
UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Try again later.
RATE_LIMITED: Slow down a bit! You've hit the request limit, try again in a few seconds.
TEAM_PREMIUM_REQUIRED: Only Premium users can create or manage a team.
TEAM_HOST_NOT_PREMIUM: This team's manager no longer has Premium, so the team can't take new members.
TEAM_NAME_INVALID: The team name must be 1 to 50 characters.
MEMBER_CANNOT_HOST: You can't manage a team while you're a member of another one.
CANNOT_JOIN_AS_HOST: You manage a team, so you can't join another one.
ALREADY_IN_TEAM: You're already a member of another team.
NOT_TEAM_HOST: Only the team's manager can do this.
NOT_TEAM_MEMBER: Only the team's members can view it.
NOT_IN_TEAM: You're not a member of this team.
INVITE_CODE_FORMAT: The invite code must be 8 digits.
INVITE_CODE_INVALID: This invite code doesn't exist or has expired.
IMPORT_PREMIUM_REQUIRED: You've used your free imports. Importing recipes is part of Premium.
IMPORT_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: You've reached the limit of {{limit}} imports per 30 days. Try again later.
MISSING_URL: Paste a link to the recipe page.
NOT_HTTPS: Only secure (https) links can be imported.
PRIVATE_ADDRESS: Only public websites can be imported.
HOST_NOT_FOUND: The site wasn't found. Check that the link is right.
PAGE_TOO_LARGE: The page is too large to process.
SITE_TIMEOUT: The site didn't respond in time. Try again later.
SITE_UNREACHABLE: We couldn't connect to the site.
PAGE_NOT_FOUND: The page wasn't found on the site. Check that the link is right.
SITE_BLOCKED: The site blocks automatic imports of this page.
SITE_ERROR: The site returned an error. Try again later.
NOT_A_PAGE: The link doesn't lead to a web page.
TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS: The link redirects too many times.
PAGE_UNREADABLE: We couldn't read the page. The site may block automatic imports.
AI_BUSY: The import service is busy. Try again in a few minutes.
AI_ERROR: The import service is unavailable right now. Try again later.
NO_RECIPE: We didn't find a recipe on this page.
MISSING_IMAGES: Add a photo of the recipe.
IMAGE_NOT_RECIPE: We didn't find a written recipe in the photo.
IMAGE_UNREADABLE: The photo is hard to read. Take it straight and in good light.
IMAGES_TOO_MANY: You can import up to 3 photos at a time.
IMAGE_INVALID: We couldn't open this photo. Try another one.
TEXT_TOO_SHORT: The shared text is too short to be a recipe.
TEXT_TOO_LONG: The shared text is too long. Share only the recipe.
TEXT_NO_RECIPE: We didn't find a recipe in the shared text.
SOCIAL_NO_RECIPE: We didn't find the recipe in the post's caption. If it's only in the video, share screenshots of it instead.
SHARE_UNSUPPORTED: Matamim can import links, text and photos of recipes. Videos and other files can't be imported.
